title: Calibration Language Shapes Block-Influence Pruning in Multilingual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block Influence (BI) ranks Transformer blocks for depth pruning from their input-output cosine change, but the ranking depends on the calibration distribution. We study whether English calibration transfers to Indian languages in Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-1B, and Gemma-2-2B. English, Hindi, Marathi, and Tamil use disjoint Wikipedia articles for calibration and evaluation; every selector receives the same 150-chunk budget, and Tamil is excluded from multilingual aggregation to test cross-script transfer. Across all three models, late-block BI is 20.7-55.5% higher for the three Indian languages than for English, and every predeclared late-minus-middle contrast has a 95% bootstrap interval above zero. This mismatch changes the low-BI blocks selected for removal despite high global rank correlations. translated_title: 校准语言如何塑造多语言语言模型中的块影响剪枝
translated_abstract: 块影响度通过计算Transformer块的输入-输出余弦变化来为深度剪枝中的块排序，但该排序依赖于所使用的校准分布。我们研究了在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-1B和Gemma-2-2B三个模型上，英语校准是否能够迁移到印度语言。英语、印地语、马拉地语和泰米尔语使用互不重叠的维基百科文章进行校准和评估；每个选择器都获得相同的150个文本块预算，并且泰米尔语被排除在多语言聚合之外，以测试跨文字系统的迁移能力。在所有三个模型中，三种印度语言的深层块BI比英语高出20.7%至55.5%，且每个预先声明的“深层块减中间块”对比的95%自助法置信区间均大于零。尽管全局秩相关性很高，这种不匹配仍改变了被选中移除的低BI块。在英语、印地语和马拉地语等量预算上对BI取平均，可以缓解Qwen模型在移除六个块时的困惑度损失，并且……
tldr: 该论文首次系统揭示剪枝校准语言会显著影响块影响排序——印度语言的深层块BI比英语高出20.7%-55.5%，导致剪枝选块不同，而多语言平均校准可有效缓解剪枝带来的困惑度损失。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that calibration language significantly shapes Block-Influence pruning rankings—Indian languages show 20.7-55.5% higher late-block BI than English—and averaging BI across multiple languages mitigates the pruning-induced perplexity damage.
